policy.network: one retrained H18 GRU/sign/anchor mixture checkpoint for ALL cases
policy.likelihood: captured original independent physical mixture; free marginalized random intercept
policy.selection: equal-state/equal-window validation; seeded promotion guarded by paired physical-particle SE
policy.split: physical pid modulo 5: test=0; validation=1; fit=2,3,4
policy.missing_state: omit absent state from all reductions; never borrow held-out particles
policy.PDE: original momentum/Vinen, Fns coefficient 2/3, initial fields only, no delta F or learned closure
policy.CF: Shen walls, nu_s=0; free raw 180fps intervals; captured original 1ms composite
policy.scope: two shared-initial windows; 5--17ms periodic and 24ms CF; not full 100ms recordings
